Sherrod Brown

Democratic candidate for United States Senate (Unexpired Term Ending 01/03/2029), Ohio · Challenger

Former U.S. Senator; candidate for U.S. Senate

Sherrod Brown is the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate seat from Ohio whose term ends January 3, 2029. Jon Husted, a Republican, holds the seat now. Brown has held elected office in Ohio for many years.

Where Brown stands

Cost of living
Says life is too expensive and that the system is rigged. His campaign says it is working to fix that.
Prescription drug costs
Lists lowering prescription drug costs as one of his top priorities.
Data centers
Would require data centers to pay the full cost of their utilities. Has criticized Husted's support for tax breaks for data center developers.
Crime and policing
Has said he supports giving police officers the resources, training and support they need. Has sponsored bills on de-escalation training and on banning chokeholds and no-knock warrants.
